name: standing isometric shoulder internal rotation against wall
description: An isometric hold pressing the inner forearm into a wall to work the shoulder rotators. There is no movement, only steady tension.
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Place the inside of your fist or forearm against the wall.
Press into the wall as if rotating your arm inward.
Keep your elbow at your side, then switch arms.
